# Remotely Save reference vectors

`vectors.json` is generated by `tests/interop/generate-remotely-save.mjs` from
pinned upstream exports with only import and browser-runtime shims. The JSON
contains synthetic passwords/data, never operator credentials. Source URLs and
SHA-256 hashes are embedded. Downloaded originals and shims stay under the
container's `/artifacts/reference-*`, outside the repository.

Names cover Unicode, folder markers and both reserved metadata names. Bodies
cover empty/binary data, AES block boundaries and 64-KiB chunk boundaries. Fixed
salt/nonce makes the byte outputs reproducible. The generator also feeds driver
outputs to the upstream decryptors; ordinary tests compare against these fixed
outputs without downloading reference code.

Through the authorized capped container launcher, regenerate with `--write` or
check with `--check`:

```sh
timeout 1800 .devcontainer/run.sh --run-dir "$R/vectors" -- deno run --allow-read --allow-write --allow-net --allow-env tests/interop/generate-remotely-save.mjs --revision 34db181af002f8d71ea0a87e7965abc57b294914 --check tests/fixtures/remotely-save
```

Use the plan's disk-backed `R` and host `TMPDIR`, and a fresh run directory.
